name: Tokigawa (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Tokigawa town emblem in light blue, green and orange: a light blue curved stroke beneath green leaf-like strokes and an orange disc.
history: Municipal flag of Tokigawa, a town in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 February 2006.

features.role: Tokigawa town emblem — a light blue curved stroke beneath green leaf-like strokes and an orange disc
